derivation.method: lab/verify-ground-truth.py, run from inside labnet via `lab/run.sh verify`. Python standard-library sockets only: it shares no code, no port table and no fingerprint data with bathy, and it consults neither Nmap nor any of its data files. Every `product`/`version` below is transcribed from a banner that script read; `lab/README.md` quotes them.
derivation.swept_ports: 1-65535 TCP on every address listed here, including the absent ones

open.evidence: accepts a connection and volunteers no bytes; PostgreSQL speaks only when spoken to, so the lab establishes that something is listening here and does not establish a product name
